versions.changelog: Fix: Added YAML frontmatter with proper name and description for ClawHub display
Agent-friendly improvements: new commands, better SKILL.md, heartbeat integration

Initial public release of ERC-8004 Reputation Skill.

- Interact with the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry to look up agent reputation, leave feedback, and manage reputation across multiple chains.
- Supports reading individual agent scores, listing reviewers, viewing specific feedback entries, and revoking feedback.
- Write operations (giving/revoking feedback) require wallet configuration via mnemonic or private key.
- Compatible with Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Monad, and BNB chains; contract addresses documented.
- Includes command-line examples and detailed usage instructions for all core features.
